rootCause: Vercel Preview Deployment requires Vercel Single Sign-On / Team Authentication header or cookie.
mitigation: Per Non-Negotiable Rules 4 and 5, automated remote mutation was held in FAIL-CLOSED state to strictly prevent potential cross-talk with production database.

rootCause: Production is strictly READ-ONLY. Zero mutations permitted.
mitigation: Production environment protected under Non-Negotiable Rule 1.

rootCause: Attempted self-demotion by Platform Owner actorId === targetUserId.
mitigation: Atomic role modification rejects self-alteration fail-closed.

rootCause: Attempted demotion of the last active Platform Owner with 1 or 0 remaining active owners.
mitigation: Acquires SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on active owners; if remaining count < 1, aborts transaction.

rootCause: Role modification request lacked required business justification (length < 5).
mitigation: Enforced minimum 5 character business reason on privileged mutations.
Strict integer duration bounds [1, 365] enforced fail-closed.

rootCause: CASHFREE_GATEWAY_CONFIG feature flag previously contained raw secretKey.
mitigation: Endpoint completely strips CASHFREE_GATEWAY_CONFIG and redacts credential tokens.
